DIAGNOSIS READY: Allergic Bronchopulmonary Aspergillosis (ABPA) secondary to undiagnosed Asthma.

Based on the normal spirometry ratio despite reduced volumes and the CT findings of diffuse airway thickening with lobar opacities, this clinical picture strongly suggests ABPA rather than typical bronchitis or bronchiectasis.
